fields.title: Balaclava Ruins and Marine Park Visit
fields.short_description: Explore the old Balaclava ruins and the nearby marine park coast.
fields.description: Explore the old stone ruins on the shore at Balaclava with a guide who explains their history. Then spend time at the nearby marine park coast, with calm water and quiet scenery on the north-west of the island.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the chapel car park at 4 p.m.
fields.inclusions:
Local guide
Bottled water
Entry fees (if applicable)
fields.itinerary_text:
09:00 – Meet at the ruins
09:15 – Guided tour of the ruins
10:30 – Shore walk
11:30 – Marine park visit
12:30 – Tour ends

fields.title: Cap Malheureux Chapel and Coastal Walk
fields.short_description: A golden-hour walk to the red-roofed chapel at Cap Malheureux.
fields.description: Visit the red-roofed Notre Dame Auxiliatrice chapel and walk the north coast in the late afternoon light. See the islets offshore, learn about the area’s history and take photos at the lookout.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the chapel car park at 4 p.m.
fields.itinerary_text:
16:00 – Meet at the chapel
16:15 – Chapel visit
16:45 – Coastal walk and viewpoints
17:45 – Sunset photos
18:15 – Walk ends

fields.title: Mahébourg Waterfront and Naval Museum Walk
fields.short_description: A guided walk along the Mahébourg waterfront and through its naval history.
fields.description: Walk along the Mahébourg waterfront with a guide, visit the National History Museum, and hear the story of the 1810 naval battle fought in the bay. Enjoy the views of the lagoon and the lively town centre.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the waterfront near the town centre at 9 a.m.
fields.inclusions:
Local guide
Museum entry
Bottled water
fields.itinerary_text:
09:00 – Meet at the waterfront
09:20 – Waterfront walk
10:15 – National History Museum
11:15 – Town centre and free time
12:00 – Walk ends

fields.title: Eureka Creole House and Gardens Tour
fields.short_description: our a 19th-century Creole house and its gardens in Moka.
fields.description: Visit Eureka, a historic Creole house in Moka, with a guide who explains how families lived in the 19th century. Walk through the rooms and the gardens, and finish your visit near a small waterfall.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the entrance of the house at 10 a.m.
fields.itinerary_text:
10:00 – Meet at the entrance
10:15 – Guided tour of the house
11:15 – Gardens and waterfall walk
12:00 – Tour ends

fields.title: La Vanille Nature Park and Tortoise Visit
fields.short_description: Meet giant tortoises and explore the gardens of La Vanille Nature Park.
fields.description: Walk through the gardens of La Vanille Nature Park and see the giant tortoises up close. Visit the crocodile area and the insect collection, and learn about the wildlife and plants of the south.
fields.location_name: Walk through the gardens of La Vanille Nature Park and see the giant tortoises up close. Visit the crocodile area and the insect collection, and learn
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the park entrance at 10 a.m.
fields.inclusions:
Park entry
Guided visit
Bottled water
fields.itinerary_text:
10:00 – Meet at the entrance
10:15 – Tortoise area
11:00 – Crocodile and insect collection
12:00 – Garden walk
12:30 – Visit ends

fields.title: Casela Nature Park Day
fields.short_description: A full day at Casela Nature Park with wildlife and outdoor activities.
fields.description: Spend the day at Casela Nature Park near Cascavelle. Walk the park, see the wildlife areas, enjoy the safari-style viewing and choose from the park’s activities. A good outing for families and groups of friends.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the park entrance at 9:30 a.m.
fields.inclusions:
Park entry
Guide for the group
Bottled water
fields.itinerary_text:
09:30 – Meet at the entrance
10:00 – Guided walk through the park
12:30 – Lunch break (not included)
14:00 – Free time for activities
16:00 – Day ends

fields.title: Tamarind Falls Guided Trek
fields.short_description: A guided forest trek to the Tamarind Falls, also called the Seven Cascades.
fields.description: A guided trek through forest to the Tamarind Falls, a series of tiered waterfalls. The route is steep and slippery in places, so a guide is required. Good fitness, sturdy shoes and a dry change of clothes are recommended.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the start of the trail at 7:00 a.m. Details are sent after booking.
fields.inclusions:
Licensed guide
Safety briefing
Water and snack
fields.itinerary_text:
07:00 – Meet and safety briefing
07:30 – Forest trek begins
10:00 – Falls viewpoint and rest
11:00 – Return hike
13:00 – Trek ends

fields.title: Rochester Falls and Souillac Coast Tour
fields.short_description: A day in the south visiting Rochester Falls and the Souillac cliffs.
fields.description:
Visit Rochester Falls, known for its wide rocky curtain of water, then follow the wild south coast to the Souillac cliffs and lookouts. Your guide explains the geology and the stories of the area, and there is time for photos at each stop.
Location name: Souillac, South coast
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the Souillac village car park, or ask for pickup from your hotel.
fields.inclusions:
Guide
Transport between stops
Bottled water
fields.itinerary_text:
09:00 – Meet in Souillac
09:30 – Rochester Falls
11:00 – South coast cliffs and viewpoints
12:30 – Free time in Souillac
13:30 – Tour ends

fields.title: Le Pouce Mountain Sunrise Hike
fields.short_description: A guided early-morning climb to the summit of Le Pouce for sunrise views.
fields.description: Climb Le Pouce, the thumb-shaped mountain above Port Louis, with an experienced guide. Start in the dark, reach the top as the sky lightens, and enjoy views over the capital, the Moka range and the sea. Bring water, a light jacket and sturdy shoes.
fields.pickup_details: Meet at the trailhead car park at 5:30 a.m.
fields.inclusions:
Mountain guide
Water
Light breakfast snack
Safety briefing
fields.itinerary_text:
05:30 – Meet at the trailhead
05:45 – Start the climb
07:00 – Summit and sunrise
08:00 – Descent
09:00 – Return to the car park

fields.title: Curepipe Botanical Garden Walk
fields.short_description: A relaxed guided stroll through the Curepipe Botanical Garden and its shaded paths.
fields.description: Walk through the Curepipe Botanical Garden with a local guide and discover old trees, palms and quiet lawns in the cool central highlands. Learn how the plants adapt to the climate here and why the garden is a favourite place for families and photographers.
fields.inclusions:
Local guide
Garden entry (if applicable)
Bottled water
fields.itinerary_text:
09:00 – Meet at the main entrance
09:15 – Guided walk through the main avenues
10:15 – Free time for photos
10:45 – Walk ends
